description: Pins INSIDE the horizon-ciphertrust image (infra-ik4p.1): the maven build image, the build plugins, javassist and our own tink-ciphertrust. Runs from mdapi/fleet's `renovate` job, which lists this repo in RENOVATE_REPOSITORIES. The readers (Dockerfile FROM, maven, the `# renovate:` ARG regex), the house core, OSV alerts and the dependency-proxy alias come from the shared preset local>mdapi/renovate-config:image-repo; do not set enabledManagers or postUpgradeTasks here, since a repo value REPLACES the preset's. MR-only: nothing in this repo automerges.

packageRules.description: The Horizon base is registry.evertrust.io, which answers 401 without credentials, and mdapi/fleet's renovate job has none for it. HORIZON_VERSION moves by hand until it does.
The provided and system jars (tink, scala-library, slf4j, horizon) must match what the target Horizon image ships, NOT the newest upstream release: they move with HORIZON_VERSION, never on their own.

tink-ciphertrust is our own library (mdapi/tink-java-ciphertrust), published to that project's GitLab maven registry; the pom names no repository (ci_settings.xml does), so without this Renovate looks only on Maven Central.
